description: arXiv:2610.28658v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How much can we trust an agent to find the paper we need? As researchers, we search the literature from what we have read toward what we have not. We thus describe what we want in our own terms, which a paper may show only implicitly; our requirements grow as we read; and what we seek may lie in an empty region no paper yet covers. We introduce...
author: Dayoon Ko, Jihyuk Kim, Soyeong Jeong, Young-jun Lee, Dahyun Lee, Juyeon Kim, Gunhee Kim, Moontae Lee, Kyungjae Lee
